root_cause.text: The RDMA/core DMAH allocation handler uses an unvalidated user-supplied cpu_id to index the cpumask bitmap via cpumask_test_cpu() without checking against nr_cpu_ids, causing potential out-of-bounds memory reads.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description identifies that the cpu_id attribute is "passed directly to cpumask_test_cpu() without first verifying that the value is within the valid CPU range," and the patch diff shows the addition of `if (dmah->cpu_id >= nr_cpu_ids)` to enforce this validation.
